title: Plugins
description: Plugins installed on this instance, and what each of them loaded.

disabledWarning.title: Plugins are disabled
disabledWarning.description: Plugins are disabled by the DISABLE_PLUGINS setting and will not load until the application is restarted with it disabled.

official.label: Official
official.tooltip: Maintained or approved by Attraccess. This label does not mean the plugin is sandboxed or guaranteed safe.

community.label: Community
community.tooltip: Not on Attraccess's approved package-source allowlist. Review the source and requested permissions before installing.

marketplace.title: Plugin marketplace
marketplace.description: Find compatible plugins from configured package registries.
marketplace.searchPlaceholder: Search plugins or enter an exact package name
marketplace.safetyWarning: Review the source and requested permissions before installing.
marketplace.updateDescription: Review compatible published versions and update this installed marketplace plugin.
marketplace.noResults: No packages found. Incompatible packages remain visible with the reason they cannot be installed.
marketplace.lookupError: Could not find that package in the selected registry.
marketplace.registryTestError: Could not connect to the registry.
marketplace.installDescription: Review the package source and requested permissions before installing.
marketplace.installApproval: I acknowledge this source and its requested permissions.
marketplace.restartWarning: Installing this plugin requires an application restart to activate it.
marketplace.installSuccess: Plugin installed. The app will restart in a few seconds to activate it.
marketplace.installPermissionHelp: Sign in with a role that can manage plugins, then try again.
marketplace.installRouteHelp: Reload Attraccess to pick up the latest client. If this persists, check that the frontend and API are running the same version.
marketplace.installCompatibilityHelp: Choose a plugin version compatible with this Attraccess version.
marketplace.installVersionHelp: Refresh the marketplace and choose an available version.
marketplace.installServerHelp: Check the API server logs for the install error, then retry.
marketplace.installRetryHelp: Check the registry connection and try again.

status.licenseMissingTooltip: Not loaded: at startup the license did not cover this plugin or could not be checked. After you save a matching license key, the server restarts and loads it.
status.errorDescription: The server reported this error during startup:
status.retrySuccess: The plugin will be retried when the app restarts.
status.refusedDescription: This plugin is not compatible with this Attraccess version (for example it was built for an older plugin SDK) and is never loaded, so it cannot be retried. Install a compatible version or remove it; removing keeps its stored data. The server reported:

updatePolicy.title: Automatic updates
updatePolicy.description: Check installed packages from their original registry. Automatic updates never apply major releases, permission additions, prereleases, or deprecated packages.
updatePolicy.enabledHint: Disabled checks leave installed packages unchanged.
updatePolicy.modeHint: A plugin can use a stricter override.

availableDescription.one: One installed marketplace plugin has an update. Attraccess installs it in the maintenance window and then restarts, unless it needs other plugin changes or installing it failed. You can also review and install it now.
availableDescription.many: {{count}} installed marketplace plugins have an update. Attraccess installs them in the maintenance window and then restarts, unless an update needs other plugin changes or installing it failed. You can also review and install them now.

deleteConfirmation.title: Remove plugin?
deleteConfirmation.messageRegistry: Remove the plugin {{pluginName}}? Its code and runtime registrations will be removed and the app will reload. Its data and secrets are kept, so installing it again continues with them.
deleteConfirmation.messageUploaded: Remove the plugin {{pluginName}}? Its code, runtime registrations and all of its stored data will be deleted permanently, and the app will reload. Create a backup first if you might need the data.
deleteConfirmation.messageRefused: Remove the refused plugin {{pluginName}}? Its files will be removed without running its code, and the app will reload. Its stored data stays in the database until a compatible version takes it over.

versions.title: Could not load versions
versions.description: The installed package was not changed. Please try again.

replace.title: Could not replace the plugin
replace.description: The current version is still active. Please try again.

delete.title: Could not remove the plugin
delete.description: The plugin is still installed. Please try again.

replace.title: Plugin version replaced
replace.description: The app will restart in a few seconds to activate the selected version.

delete.title: Plugin removed
delete.description: The app will reload in a few seconds to drop the plugin's code.

versionManagement.title: Manage {{pluginName}} version
versionManagement.policyError: Could not save plugin version policy
versionManagement.majorApproval: I approve this major version update and its restart/downtime.
versionManagement.downgradeWarning: Downgrading can affect plugin data and requires an application restart.

dependencies.title: Plugin dependencies
dependencies.description: Required plugins, including transitive dependencies, are included in this operation.
dependencies.removalDescription: Keep this plugin, or explicitly remove the following dependants together. Plugin data is retained.
dependencies.approveChanges: I approve installing these dependencies and their permissions
